ukSafeKey.true: expired/free in UK and US on the evidence seen
ukSafeKey.likely: anonymous or very old; probable but confirm
ukSafeKey.editorial-only: fine to display editorially; do not print on products without advice

policy: Self-host approved images; do not hotlink upload.wikimedia.org. Show 'attribution' beside every image. Never ship status != approved* without nou's/rights sign-off.

tiers.A: Public domain or CC0: safe for editorial and (subject to design review) products
tiers.A-CC: CC BY-SA: editorial use with attribution; share-alike applies to adaptations; do NOT use as product artwork
tiers.B: Probably fine but provenance/licence needs checking at source
tiers.C: HOLD: licence rests on Iranian-law tag or unknown author within the UK 70-year window
